actor_identity_facts.claim: Caller/payer remains msg.sender for repayments and deposits; borrower is a separate authorization identity. Fee collector differs from feeRecipient; claim executor differs from withdrawal account and possible escrow recipient.

Operational borrower and borrowerPrincipal occupy separate slots. onlyBorrower reads current operational borrower. Lender sanctions/escrow use current principal; raw borrow/transfer sanctions inspect operational and principal identities.

runtime_variant_facts.claim: Config runtime inherits empty Base._blockAccount; full WildcatMarket runtime uses its balance-queueing override.

Revolving exposes inherited mutating selectors, with virtual dispatch for _onBorrow, _onRepay, _onRepayAndGetTotalAssets, _onCloseMarket and _updateScaleFactorAndFees. Borrow uses pre-transfer assets to calculate remaining debt and can increase drawn principal; explicit repayment first covers non-principal debt and then reduces drawn principal; close clears it. Raw asset donations do not themselves invoke a principal-repayment action.

Revolving base interest combines commitment fee over supplied liquidity with annual interest weighted by min(drawnAmount,totalSupply)/totalSupply; zero time, zero supply or closed market returns zero base interest. Protocol fee and delinquency components remain distinct in scale-factor update.

_writeState checkpoints capped totalAssets while a pending batch exists; expiry processing uses that checkpoint and recomputes delinquency before subsequent accrual. Queue and repayment-processing pass explicit current assets to the store helper.
Scaled conversion for deposit, transfer and normalized queue floors through scaleAmountDown; batch settlement uses maxScaledSettleable and skips zero burn.
Forced sanctions queue passes baseCalldataSize=msg.data.length, so its queue callback receives empty extraData. Individual execute callback includes exact expiry; executeMany passes empty extraData.
